passages.title: 集點換公仔
passages.text: Kevin loves the little toy cats at the convenience store near his home. Every time he buys something there, he gets one sticker. To get a toy cat, he has to {1} forty stickers. At first, he bought a drink every day. {2}, he started buying snacks too, just for the stickers. His mom was not happy. "You are spending all your money on junk food," she said. Kevin thought about it and {3} with her. So he made a new plan. He asked his family to give him their stickers. Even his grandpa helped. In two weeks, Kevin had forty stickers {4} buying any more snacks. To {5}, he shared a cake with everyone. Now the toy cat sits on his desk, and it reminds him that there is always a smarter way.

blanks.why: collect stickers「收集貼紙」。agree（同意）、join（加入）、celebrate（慶祝）接 forty stickers 意思都不通。
Later「後來」放句首，表示時間往後：後來他連零食也開始買。Without、Together、Until 單獨放在句首都不能修飾整句。
agree with + 人「同意某人的看法」：他想了想，同意媽媽說的。ordered、caught、collected 都不能接 with her 表示同意。
without + V-ing「沒有做…」：沒有再買任何零食就集滿了。later、during、than 不能這樣接動名詞表示「沒有」。
To celebrate「為了慶祝」：為了慶祝，他和大家分享蛋糕。To order、To catch、To turn 後面沒有受詞，意思不通。

passages.zh: Kevin 很喜歡他家附近便利商店的小貓公仔。他每次在那裡買東西，就能拿到一張貼紙。要換一隻小貓公仔，他必須收集四十張貼紙。一開始，他每天買一瓶飲料。後來，他為了貼紙連零食也開始買。媽媽很不高興：「你把錢都花在垃圾食物上了。」Kevin 想了想，同意媽媽說的話。於是他想了一個新計畫：請家人把他們的貼紙給他，連爺爺都來幫忙。兩個星期後，Kevin 沒有再多買零食，就集滿了四十張貼紙。為了慶祝，他和大家一起分享蛋糕。現在小貓公仔就坐在他的書桌上，提醒他：總是有更聰明的辦法。

passages.title: 婚禮上的捧花
passages.text: My aunt got married last Saturday, and our whole family went to {1} with her. The party was in a big garden. At the end, my aunt stood with her back to the crowd and threw her flowers into the air. People say the person who {2} the flowers will be the next to get married. All the young women ran forward, but the flowers flew over their heads and landed in the arms of my little cousin, Ben. He is only six! Everyone laughed. Ben looked at the flowers, then {3} to his mom. "Can I eat these?" he asked. We all laughed even harder. {4} that night, my aunt gave Ben a big hug. "I will always {5} this day," she said.

blanks.why: celebrate with + 人「和某人一起慶祝」。collect、catch、order with her 意思都不通。
catch the flowers「接住捧花」。joins、agrees、celebrates 接 the flowers 意思不通。
turn to + 人「轉向某人」：Ben 轉頭看媽媽。ordered、agreed、collected to his mom 都不通。
Later that night「那天晚上稍後」。Without、Than、Because 不能和 that night 連用表示時間。
remember this day「記得這一天」。catch、agree、join this day 意思不通。

passages.zh: 我阿姨上星期六結婚了，我們全家都去和她一起慶祝。派對在一座大花園裡舉行。最後，阿姨背對著人群，把捧花往空中一丟。大家都說，接到捧花的人就是下一個結婚的人。年輕的女生們全都往前衝，但捧花飛過她們頭頂，落進了我小表弟 Ben 的懷裡。他才六歲！大家都笑了。Ben 看看捧花，然後轉頭問媽媽：「這個可以吃嗎？」我們笑得更大聲了。那天晚上稍後，阿姨給了 Ben 一個大大的擁抱。「我會永遠記得這一天。」她說。

passages.title: 輪到我當值日生
passages.text: In our class, two students clean the classroom and take care of the plants every week. This week, it is my {1}. My partner is Sam, but on Monday he forgot about it and went home early. So I did all the work {2} him. On Tuesday, I was angry. "You should {3} your job," I said. Sam said sorry. He told me his grandma was sick, and he had to go to the hospital after school. I felt bad. "Let's make a deal," I said. "I will do the work this week, and you can do it next week." Sam {4} right away. On Friday, he came to school early with a small box of cookies. "Thank you for helping me," he said. Now we are good friends, and we often do our work {5}.

blanks.why: It is my turn.「輪到我了。」turn 當名詞是「輪流的次序」。order、fact、story 放進去意思不通。
without + 人「沒有某人（幫忙）」：我在沒有他的情況下做完所有工作。later、than、because 不能直接接 him 這樣用。
remember your job「記得你的工作」。celebrate、collect、catch your job 意思不通。
agree「同意」可以單獨使用：Sam 馬上就同意了。collected、caught、invited 都需要受詞，放在這裡句子不完整。
do our work together「一起做我們的工作」。without 後面要接名詞；least、than 放句尾都不通。

passages.zh: 我們班每週有兩個學生負責打掃教室、照顧植物。這個星期輪到我了。我的搭檔是 Sam，但星期一他忘了這件事，提早回家了。所以我一個人做完了所有工作。星期二我很生氣：「你應該記得你的工作。」我說。Sam 跟我道歉，他說他奶奶生病了，放學後他得去醫院。我覺得很過意不去。「我們來約定吧，」我說，「這星期我來做，下星期換你做。」Sam 馬上就同意了。星期五，他帶著一小盒餅乾很早就到學校。「謝謝你幫我。」他說。現在我們成了好朋友，也常常一起做事。

passages.title: 加入熱舞社
passages.text: At the start of the school year, Amy wanted to {1} the dance club. But she was shy, and she was worried that she could not dance well. On the first day, she stood outside the club room for ten minutes. Finally, an older student saw her and asked, "Do you want to come in?" Amy nodded. The teacher played a fast song, and everyone started to move. Amy could not {2} up with the others. She kept making mistakes and almost cried. "Don't worry," said the older student. "Nobody can dance well {3} practice." So Amy practiced every night in her room. She watched videos and {4} every step. Three months {5}, the club danced at the school festival. Amy was in the front row, and she was smiling the whole time.

blanks.why: join the club「加入社團」。agree、collect、catch the dance club 意思都不通。
catch up with + 人「跟上某人」：Amy 跟不上其他人。join up、order up、celebrate up 都不是片語。
without practice「沒有練習」：沒有人不練習就能跳得好。later、together、than 不能這樣接名詞。
remember every step「記住每一個舞步」。agreed、ordered、joined every step 意思不通。
時間 + later「…之後」：三個月後。without、until、together 放在 three months 後面都不通。

passages.zh: 學期一開始，Amy 想加入熱舞社。但她很害羞，也擔心自己跳不好。第一天，她在社團教室外面站了十分鐘。最後，一位學姊看到她，問她：「要進來嗎？」Amy 點點頭。老師放了一首節奏很快的歌，大家開始跳舞。Amy 跟不上其他人，一直出錯，差點哭出來。「別擔心，」學姊說，「沒有人不練習就能跳得好。」於是 Amy 每天晚上在房間裡練習，她看影片，記住每一個舞步。三個月後，熱舞社在校慶上表演。Amy 站在第一排，從頭到尾都在笑。

passages.title: 漢堡店的點餐機
passages.text: At the new burger shop, there are no people at the counter. Customers {1} their food on a big screen. My grandpa wanted to try it. He touched the screen slowly, but he pressed the wrong button again and again. In the end, he {2} ten cheeseburgers! When the food came, he looked surprised. "I can't eat all of these!" he said. We could not finish them, so we gave some to the people waiting in line. Everyone was happy. A little girl said, "Thank you! Is it your birthday?" Grandpa laughed. "No, but let's {3} anyway!" {4}, a worker showed him how to use the machine, and Grandpa {5} to try again next week.

blanks.why: order food「點餐」：客人在大螢幕上點餐。catch、join、agree their food 意思不通。
order + 餐點「點了…」：他點了十個起司漢堡。remembered、celebrated、agreed 接 ten cheeseburgers 意思不通。
let's celebrate「我們來慶祝吧」，celebrate 可以不接受詞。catch、collect、join 都需要受詞，放在這裡句子不完整。
Later「後來」放句首：後來店員教他怎麼用機器。Without、Than、Until 不能單獨放在句首。
agree to + 原形動詞「同意做…」：爺爺同意下星期再試一次。ordered、caught、joined 不能接 to try 表示「答應」。

passages.zh: 新開的漢堡店櫃檯沒有店員，客人都在一個大螢幕上點餐。我爺爺想試試看。他慢慢地點螢幕，卻一再按錯按鈕。結果，他點了十個起司漢堡！餐點送來時，他嚇了一跳：「我吃不完這麼多啦！」我們真的吃不完，就分給排隊的人。大家都很開心。一個小女孩說：「謝謝您！今天是您的生日嗎？」爺爺笑著說：「不是，不過我們還是來慶祝一下吧！」後來，店員教他怎麼用機器，爺爺也答應下星期再試一次。

passages.title: 星期一的作業
passages.text: On Sunday night, I finished my English homework and put it on my desk. "Don't forget to bring it tomorrow," Mom said. "I will {1}," I said. But on Monday morning, I woke up late. I ran to the bus stop and just {2} the bus. In class, the teacher started to {3} our homework. I opened my bag and looked inside. It wasn't there! I came to school {4} it. My face turned red. Then my phone shook in my pocket. It was a photo from Mom: my homework on the desk. At lunchtime, Mom came to school with my homework. I said thank you again and again. "You can thank me {5}," she said with a smile. "Now go back to class!"

blanks.why: I will remember.「我會記得。」remember 可以不接受詞，回答「別忘了帶」。catch、join、collect 都需要受詞，放在這裡句子不完整。
catch the bus「趕上公車」：我跑到公車站，剛好趕上公車。ordered、celebrated、agreed the bus 意思不通。
collect homework「收作業」：老師開始收作業。celebrate、catch、agree our homework 意思不通。
without it「沒有帶它」：我沒帶作業就來上學了。later、together、than 不能接 it 這樣用。
thank me later「晚點再謝我」，later 修飾動詞。without、than、because 放在句尾都不通。

passages.zh: 星期天晚上，我寫完英文作業，把它放在書桌上。「明天別忘了帶。」媽媽說。「我會記得的。」我說。可是星期一早上，我睡過頭了。我跑到公車站，剛好趕上公車。上課時，老師開始收作業。我打開書包往裡面看──作業不在裡面！我沒帶作業就來上學了。我的臉一下子紅了。接著口袋裡的手機震動了，是媽媽傳來的照片：我的作業就躺在書桌上。午餐時間，媽媽把作業送到學校來。我一直跟她說謝謝。「晚點再謝我吧，」她笑著說，「現在快回教室！」

passages.title: 狗狗的生日派對
passages.text: Today is Lucky's third birthday. Lucky is our dog, and my little brother wants to {1} it with a big party. He made a cake out of dog food and put a candle on it. He also invited the dogs in our neighborhood, and three of them {2} the party. We played a game in the yard: I threw a ball, and the dogs ran to {3} it. Everyone had fun, but Lucky didn't run. He sat next to the cake and looked at it. When we {4} around, the cake was gone! Lucky ate the whole thing {5} sharing. My brother wasn't angry. "It's his birthday," he said. "He can do what he wants today."

blanks.why: celebrate a birthday「慶祝生日」：用一場大派對來慶祝。join、catch、agree it 意思不通。
join the party「參加派對」：有三隻狗來參加派對。ordered、agreed、collected the party 意思不通。
catch a ball「接球」：狗跑去接球。order、agree、celebrate it 意思不通。
turn around「轉身」：我們一轉身，蛋糕就不見了。ordered、agreed、collected around 都不是片語。
without + V-ing「沒有…」：Lucky 一口都沒分給別人就吃光了。later、than、during 不能這樣接 sharing。

passages.zh: 今天是 Lucky 的三歲生日。Lucky 是我們家的狗，我弟弟想辦一場大派對來慶祝。他用狗飼料做了一個蛋糕，還插上一根蠟燭。他也邀請了附近的狗狗，有三隻來參加派對。我們在院子裡玩遊戲：我丟球，狗狗們跑去接。大家都玩得很開心，只有 Lucky 不跑。牠坐在蛋糕旁邊盯著它看。等我們一轉身，蛋糕就不見了！Lucky 一口都沒分給別人，整個吃光了。我弟弟沒有生氣：「今天是牠的生日，」他說，「牠今天想做什麼都可以。」

passages.title: 沒有網路的一週
passages.text: Last summer, my family stayed in a small mountain village for a week. There was no Internet there. "How can I live {1} my phone?" I asked. For the first two days, I was bored. I kept {2} my phone on and off, but nothing changed. Then a boy from the village asked me to {3} him on a fishing trip. We went to the river, and I {4} my first fish! After that, we explored the forest every day. We found wild fruit, swam in the river, and watched the stars at night. A week {5}, it was time to go home. I was surprised that I didn't want to leave.

blanks.why: live without + 名詞「沒有…而生活」：沒有手機我要怎麼活？later、than、until 接 my phone 意思不通。
turn … on and off「把…開了又關」：我一直把手機開開關關。joining、ordering、agreeing 不能和 on and off 連用。
join + 人「和某人一起（做某事）」：他邀我跟他一起去釣魚。agree、order、catch him 意思不通。
catch a fish「釣到一條魚」。ordered、celebrated、joined my first fish 意思不通。
時間 + later「…之後」：一週後該回家了。without、than、together 放在 a week 後面都不通。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我們全家在一個山上的小村莊住了一個星期。那裡沒有網路。「沒有手機我要怎麼活？」我問。頭兩天我很無聊，一直把手機開了又關，但什麼也沒改變。後來，村裡一個男孩邀我和他一起去釣魚。我們到了河邊，我釣到了人生第一條魚！之後我們每天去森林探險，找野生的果子、在河裡游泳，晚上看星星。一個星期後，該回家了。我很驚訝自己竟然不想離開。

passages.title: 雨水實驗
passages.text: Our science teacher gave us a project: {1} rainwater and find out if it is clean. My partner Tina and I put a big bowl on the roof of her house. That night, it rained hard. The next morning, we found the bowl full of water. But there was also a small frog in it! "Did it fall from the sky?" Tina asked. I laughed. "I don't think so. Maybe it jumped in to {2} bugs." We let the frog go. Then we tested the water. It looked clean, but it had dust and tiny bugs in it. "So we can't drink rainwater {3} cleaning it first," I said. Tina {4}. We wrote a report and got an A. "I will always {5} that frog," Tina said with a smile.

blanks.why: collect rainwater「收集雨水」。celebrate、agree、join rainwater 意思不通。
catch bugs「抓蟲子」：青蛙可能是跳進來抓蟲吃的。order、agree、remember bugs 意思不通。
without + V-ing「沒有先…」：沒先把雨水處理乾淨就不能喝。later、than、together 不能這樣接 cleaning。
agree 可以單獨使用：Tina 同意（我的說法）。ordered、caught、celebrated 放在這裡意思不通。
remember that frog「記得那隻青蛙」。collect、order、join that frog 意思不通（青蛙已經放走了）。

passages.zh: 自然老師給我們一個作業：收集雨水，看看它乾不乾淨。我和搭檔 Tina 在她家屋頂上放了一個大碗。那天晚上雨下得很大。隔天早上，碗裡裝滿了水，可是裡面還有一隻小青蛙！「牠是從天上掉下來的嗎？」Tina 問。我笑了：「應該不是吧，牠可能是跳進來抓蟲的。」我們把青蛙放走，然後檢驗雨水。水看起來很乾淨，但裡面有灰塵和小蟲。「所以雨水沒有先處理乾淨是不能喝的。」我說。Tina 也同意。我們寫了報告，拿到 A。「我會永遠記得那隻青蛙。」Tina 笑著說。

passages.title: 抓寶可夢走太遠
passages.text: My cousin Leo loves Pokémon GO. One Saturday, he went out to {1} a rare Pokémon in the park. He walked and walked with his eyes on his phone, and he didn't notice where he was going. An hour {2}, he looked up and didn't know where he was. His phone battery was almost dead. He walked into a small shop and asked the owner for help. The kind old man let him use the shop's phone. Leo called his mom, but he couldn't {3} the name of the street. So the old man talked to her. Soon, Mom came in her car. On the way home, Leo {4} to look up more often when he walks. And the rare Pokémon? He never {5} it.

blanks.why: catch a Pokémon「抓寶可夢」。join、agree、celebrate a rare Pokémon 意思不通。
時間 + later「…之後」：一小時後他抬起頭。without、than、together 放在 an hour 後面都不通。
remember the name「記得名字」：他想不起街名。order、agree、collect the name 意思不通。
agree to + 原形動詞「答應做…」：Leo 答應走路時要多抬頭看。joined、caught、ordered 不能接 to look up 表示答應。
catch it「抓到牠」：他始終沒抓到那隻稀有寶可夢。celebrated、ordered、agreed it 意思不通。

passages.zh: 我表弟 Leo 很愛玩寶可夢 GO。有一個星期六，他到公園去抓一隻稀有的寶可夢。他眼睛盯著手機一直走，完全沒注意自己往哪裡去。一個小時後，他抬起頭，發現自己不知道身在何處。他的手機快沒電了，於是走進一家小店請老闆幫忙。好心的老爺爺讓他用店裡的電話。Leo 打給媽媽，卻想不起來這條街叫什麼。所以老爺爺跟媽媽講。不久，媽媽就開車來了。回家路上，Leo 答應以後走路要多抬頭看。至於那隻稀有寶可夢呢？他始終沒抓到。

passages.title: 慶祝爺爺退休
passages.text: After forty years as a bus driver, Grandpa stopped working last month. Our family wanted to {1} his retirement. We all {2} that the party should be a surprise. My job was to {3} old photos of Grandpa from our relatives. Mom {4} a big cake with a bus on it. On the day of the party, Grandpa walked in, and everyone shouted, "Surprise!" He was so happy that his eyes turned wet. Then we showed him the photos. In one photo, he was young and standing next to a shiny green bus. "I {5} that day!" he said. "It was my first day at work. I was so nervous that I drove past three bus stops!" Everyone laughed. It was the best party our family ever had.

blanks.why: celebrate his retirement「慶祝他退休」。catch、collect、agree his retirement 意思不通。
agree that + 句子「同意…」：我們都同意派對要給他驚喜。ordered、caught、turned 不能接 that 子句表示意見一致。
collect photos「收集照片」：我負責向親戚收集爺爺的老照片。celebrate、turn、join old photos 意思不通。
order a cake「訂蛋糕」：媽媽訂了一個上面有公車的大蛋糕。joined、caught、agreed a cake 意思不通。
I remember that day!「我記得那一天！」join、order、agree that day 意思不通。

passages.zh: 當了四十年的公車司機，爺爺上個月終於退休了。我們家想慶祝他退休，大家都同意派對要給他一個驚喜。我的工作是向親戚們收集爺爺的老照片。媽媽訂了一個上面有公車的大蛋糕。派對那天，爺爺一走進來，大家就大喊：「驚喜！」他開心得眼眶都濕了。接著我們給他看照片。其中一張，年輕的爺爺站在一輛閃亮的綠色公車旁邊。「我記得那一天！」他說，「那是我第一天上班，我緊張到開過了三個站！」大家都笑了。那是我們家辦過最棒的派對。

passages.title: 養兔子的約定
passages.text: Jenny wanted a pet rabbit for a long time. "Can I have one, please?" she asked her parents again and again. Finally, they {1}, but there were some rules. First, she had to clean the rabbit's cage every day {2} being told. Second, she had to {3} to feed it twice a day. Jenny named the rabbit Snow. For the first month, she did everything well. But one day, she forgot to close the cage door, and Snow ran out into the garden. Jenny ran after her, but she couldn't {4} her. An hour {5}, Jenny found Snow eating Mom's vegetables. Mom was not happy at first, but then she laughed. "I think Snow likes our garden more than her cage," she said.

blanks.why: agree 可以單獨使用：爸媽終於同意了。caught、collected、celebrated 放在這裡意思不通。
without being told「不用別人提醒」：每天不用人說就要清籠子。later、than、during 不能這樣接 being told。
remember to + 原形動詞「記得要去做…」：記得一天餵兩次。order、join、catch 不能接 to feed 表示「記得」。
catch + 人／動物「抓住」：她追不到兔子。order、join、agree her 意思不通。
時間 + later「…之後」：一小時後才找到 Snow。without、than、together 放在 an hour 後面都不通。

passages.zh: Jenny 一直很想養一隻兔子。「拜託，我可以養一隻嗎？」她一次又一次地問爸媽。最後他們終於同意了，但有幾條規定。第一，她每天要清理兔子的籠子，不用別人提醒。第二，她要記得一天餵兩次。Jenny 幫兔子取名叫小雪。第一個月，她每件事都做得很好。可是有一天，她忘了關籠子的門，小雪跑進了花園。Jenny 在後面追，卻抓不到牠。一個小時後，Jenny 發現小雪正在吃媽媽種的菜。媽媽一開始很不高興，後來卻笑了：「我看小雪比較喜歡我們的菜園，不喜歡牠的籠子。」

passages.title: 趕搭渡輪去小琉球
passages.text: Last summer vacation, my friends and I planned a trip to Xiaoliuqiu, a small island near Pingtung. We had to {1} the eight o'clock boat. But my friend Eric got up late. We waited at the port, and he ran in at 7:58. We just made it! On the island, we rode bikes along the coast and saw sea turtles in the water. "Don't touch them," our guide said. "They are wild animals." We {2} and only took photos. At noon, we {3} fried rice at a small restaurant. Then we went to the beach and {4} the trash we found on the sand. That evening, we took the boat back. "Next year, let's come again," Eric said. "And this time, I'll {5} to set my alarm!"

blanks.why: catch the boat「趕上船」：我們得趕上八點的船。join、agree、collect the boat 意思不通。
agree 可以單獨使用：我們同意（導遊的話），只拍照。ordered、celebrated、caught 放在這裡意思不通。
order fried rice「點炒飯」。remembered、joined、agreed fried rice 意思不通。
collect the trash「撿拾、收集垃圾」：在沙灘上把垃圾撿起來。agreed、celebrated、ordered the trash 意思不通。
remember to + 原形動詞「記得去做…」：這次我會記得設鬧鐘。agree、order、join 不能接 to set my alarm 表示「記得」。

passages.zh: 去年暑假，我和朋友計畫去屏東附近的小島──小琉球玩。我們得趕上八點的船，可是我朋友 Eric 睡過頭了。我們在港口等他，他七點五十八分才衝進來，我們剛好趕上！到了島上，我們沿著海岸騎腳踏車，看到海裡的海龜。「不要摸牠們，」導遊說，「牠們是野生動物。」我們都同意，只有拍照。中午，我們在一家小餐廳點了炒飯。接著我們到沙灘上，把沙子上的垃圾撿起來。傍晚，我們搭船回去。「明年我們再來吧，」Eric 說，「這次我會記得設鬧鐘！」

passages.title: 瓶蓋變成的鯨魚
passages.text: Our art teacher, Mr. Chen, had a strange idea. "For the next two weeks, I want you to {1} bottle caps," he said. Everyone looked at each other. "Why?" asked Ken. "You'll see {2}," Mr. Chen answered. Soon, students from other classes {3} us. Even the teachers brought caps. In two weeks, we had more than five thousand. Then Mr. Chen showed us his plan. We put the caps on a big wall, one by one. It took a long time, but nobody gave up. When we finished, we stepped back and saw a huge picture of a blue whale. "It is made of trash," Mr. Chen said, "but it is beautiful. Old things can {4} into something new." We {5} with a small party in the art room.

blanks.why: collect bottle caps「收集瓶蓋」。celebrate、agree、join bottle caps 意思不通。
You'll see later.「你們之後就知道了。」later 修飾動詞。without、than、until 放在句尾都不通。
join + 人「加入某人（的行列）」：別班的學生也加入我們。agreed、celebrated、happened us 都不通（happen 不能接受詞）。
turn into + 名詞「變成…」：舊東西可以變成新東西。order、agree、join into 都不能表示「變成」。
celebrate with a party「用派對慶祝」。collected、ordered、caught 後面沒有受詞，接 with a small party 意思不通。

passages.zh: 我們的美術老師陳老師有個奇怪的點子。「接下來兩個星期，我要你們收集瓶蓋。」他說。大家面面相覷。「為什麼？」Ken 問。「你們之後就知道了。」陳老師回答。很快地，別班的學生也加入我們，連老師們都帶瓶蓋來。兩週後，我們收集了五千多個。接著陳老師說出他的計畫：我們把瓶蓋一個一個貼到一面大牆上。花了很長的時間，但沒有人放棄。完成之後，我們往後退一步，看見一幅巨大的藍鯨。「它是用垃圾做的，」陳老師說，「但它很美。舊的東西可以變成新的東西。」我們在美術教室開了一個小派對來慶祝。

passages.title: 精靈郵局
passages.text: Deep in the forest, there is a small post office run by elves. Every day, animals come to {1} things from all over the world. One morning, a little bear came in. "My mom's birthday is next week," he said. "I want to {2} it with a special gift." The elf, Pip, showed him a book of gifts. The bear chose a big jar of honey from a faraway mountain. "It will take five days," said Pip. On the fifth day, Pip {3} on the magic lamp and waited for the bird that carries the gifts. But the bird didn't come. Pip was worried. Then he saw the bird under a tree. It had hurt its wing, but the honey was safe. Pip took the jar and ran to the bear's house {4} stopping. He got there just in time. The bear's mom was so happy. "I will always {5} this birthday," she said.

blanks.why: order things「訂購東西」：動物們來這裡向世界各地訂東西。agree、celebrate、join things 意思不通。
celebrate it「慶祝它（生日）」。agree、catch、collect it 和生日搭配意思不通。
turn on + 物「打開（燈、電器）」：Pip 打開魔法燈。ordered、joined、collected on 都不是片語。
without stopping「一刻不停地」：他一路不停地跑。later、than、until 不能這樣接 stopping。
remember this birthday「記得這個生日」。order、agree、catch this birthday 意思不通。

passages.zh: 在森林深處，有一間由精靈經營的小郵局。每天都有動物來這裡，向世界各地訂購東西。一天早上，一隻小熊走進來。「我媽媽下星期生日，」他說，「我想送一份特別的禮物來慶祝。」精靈 Pip 拿出一本禮物目錄給他看。小熊選了一大罐來自遙遠山上的蜂蜜。「要五天才會到喔。」Pip 說。第五天，Pip 打開魔法燈，等著負責送禮物的鳥。可是鳥沒有來，Pip 很擔心。後來他在一棵樹下找到那隻鳥，牠的翅膀受傷了，但蜂蜜完好無缺。Pip 拿起罐子，一刻不停地跑到小熊家，剛好及時趕到。熊媽媽非常開心：「我會永遠記得這個生日。」她說。

passages.title: 記不住名字的老師
passages.text: Our new math teacher, Mr. Wu, is funny, but he has one problem: he can't {1} our names. He calls Amy "Annie" and calls Tom "Tim." One day, he called me "Kevin." My name is Kelvin. The whole class laughed. "I'm sorry," Mr. Wu said. "Let's play a game. Every time I get a name wrong, the class gets one point. When you {2} twenty points, I will buy everyone ice cream." Everyone {3}. For two weeks, he got many names wrong, and soon we had nineteen points. But then he called everyone by the right name! "Mr. Wu, were you getting our names wrong on purpose?" I asked. He laughed. "I learned all your names on the first day. I just wanted you to talk to me." {4} that week, he bought ice cream for everyone anyway. "Let's {5}," he said. "Now we are friends."

blanks.why: remember our names「記得我們的名字」。agree、celebrate、join our names 意思不通。
collect points「集點」：集滿二十點就請吃冰淇淋。agree、join、order twenty points 意思不通。
agree 可以單獨使用：大家都同意。caught、ordered、turned 放在這裡意思不通。
Later that week「那個星期稍後」。Without、Than、Because 不能和 that week 連用表示時間。
Let's celebrate.「我們來慶祝吧。」celebrate 可以不接受詞。catch、collect、invite 都需要受詞，放在這裡句子不完整。

passages.zh: 我們新來的數學老師吳老師很有趣，但他有個問題：他記不住我們的名字。他把 Amy 叫成「Annie」，把 Tom 叫成「Tim」。有一天他叫我「Kevin」，但我叫 Kelvin，全班都笑了。「對不起，」吳老師說，「我們來玩個遊戲吧。我每叫錯一次名字，全班就得一分。等你們集滿二十分，我就請大家吃冰淇淋。」大家都同意。兩個星期裡，他叫錯了好多名字，我們很快就有十九分了。可是後來，他每個人的名字都叫對了！「吳老師，你是故意叫錯我們的名字嗎？」我問。他笑了：「你們的名字我第一天就記住了，我只是想讓你們多跟我說話。」那個星期稍後，他還是請大家吃了冰淇淋。「我們來慶祝吧，」他說，「現在我們是朋友了。」

passages.title: 櫻木花道的第一次灌籃
passages.text: Sakuragi {1} the basketball team only because he liked a girl named Haruko. He was tall and strong, but at first, he couldn't even {2} the ball. His captain, Akagi, made him practice the basics every day. Sakuragi hated it. "I want to dunk!" he shouted. But he practiced anyway, again and again. Weeks {3}, in an important game, the ball came to him. He jumped high and slammed it into the basket! The crowd went crazy. His teammates ran to {4} with him. Haruko smiled at him from her seat. That night, Sakuragi couldn't sleep. "I will {5} this feeling forever," he said to himself. "And tomorrow, I will practice even harder."

blanks.why: join the team「加入球隊」。agreed、ordered、celebrated the basketball team 意思不通。
catch the ball「接住球」：一開始他連球都接不好。order、agree、remember the ball 意思不通。
Weeks later「幾個星期後」。without、than、together 放在 weeks 後面都不通。
celebrate with + 人「和某人一起慶祝」：隊友跑過來和他一起慶祝。collect、order、catch with him 意思不通。
remember this feeling「記住這種感覺」。join、order、agree this feeling 意思不通。

gloss: 櫻木花道（《灌籃高手》角色）
passages.zh: 櫻木花道加入籃球隊，只是因為他喜歡一個叫晴子的女生。他又高又壯，但一開始連球都接不好。隊長赤木要他每天練基本動作，櫻木討厭死了。「我想灌籃！」他大喊。但他還是一次又一次地練習。幾個星期後，在一場重要的比賽裡，球傳到了他手上。他高高跳起，把球用力灌進籃框！觀眾都瘋了，隊友們跑過來和他一起慶祝。晴子在座位上對他微笑。那天晚上，櫻木睡不著。「我會永遠記住這種感覺，」他對自己說，「明天我要練得更認真。」

passages.title: 外婆家包粽子
passages.text: Every Dragon Boat Festival, my family gets together at Grandma's house to {1}. This year, Grandma asked me to {2} her in the kitchen. She wanted to teach me how to make rice dumplings. First, she put rice, pork, and mushrooms into a bamboo leaf. Then she {3} the leaf into a neat little triangle and tied it with a string. It looked easy, but when I tried, the rice fell out everywhere. "Don't worry," Grandma said. "My first one was worse. You will get better {4}." By the end of the day, I made ten. They were not pretty, but they tasted great. "I will {5} how to do this," I said, "and teach my own kids one day."

blanks.why: get together to celebrate「聚在一起慶祝」，celebrate 可以不接受詞。catch、collect、turn 放在這裡意思不通。
join + 人「和某人一起」：外婆要我和她一起待在廚房。agree、celebrate、catch her 意思不通。
turn A into B「把 A 變成 B」：她把竹葉折成一個整齊的三角形。joined、ordered、collected the leaf into 都不能表示「變成」。
get better later「以後會進步」，later 修飾動詞。without、than、until 放在句尾都不通。
remember how to + 原形動詞「記得怎麼做…」。order、agree、join how to do this 都不通。

passages.zh: 每年端午節，我們全家都會聚在外婆家一起慶祝。今年，外婆要我和她一起待在廚房，她想教我包粽子。首先，她把米、豬肉和香菇放進竹葉裡，接著把竹葉折成一個整齊的小三角形，再用繩子綁起來。看起來很簡單，但輪到我包的時候，米掉得到處都是。「別擔心，」外婆說，「我第一顆包得更糟，你以後會越包越好。」到了傍晚，我包了十顆。雖然不好看，但吃起來很棒。「我會記住怎麼包，」我說，「以後也要教我的小孩。」

passages.title: 失聲的主持人
passages.text: Tina was chosen to host the school talent show. She practiced her lines for weeks. But two days before the show, she {1} a bad cold. On the morning of the show, she couldn't talk at all! "How can I host the show {2} my voice?" she wrote on a piece of paper. Her friend Ben {3} to help. Tina stood on the stage and held up funny signs, and Ben read them in a loud voice. The audience loved it. They laughed and clapped more than ever. After the show, the principal said, "That was the best show ever. I'll {4} it for a long time." Two days {5}, Tina's voice came back. The first thing she said was, "Thank you, Ben!"

blanks.why: catch a cold「感冒」：她得了重感冒。joined、ordered、agreed a cold 意思不通。
without my voice「沒有聲音」：沒有聲音要怎麼主持？later、than、until 接 my voice 意思不通。
agree to + 原形動詞「答應做…」：Ben 答應幫忙。ordered、caught、collected 不能接 to help 表示答應。
remember it「記得它」：我會記得這場表演很久。catch、order、agree it 意思不通。
時間 + later「…之後」：兩天後她的聲音恢復了。without、than、together 放在 two days 後面都不通。

passages.zh: Tina 被選為學校才藝表演的主持人，她練習台詞練了好幾個星期。但表演前兩天，她得了重感冒。表演當天早上，她完全發不出聲音！「沒有聲音，我要怎麼主持？」她在紙上寫著。她的朋友 Ben 答應幫忙。Tina 站在舞台上舉起好笑的牌子，Ben 大聲唸出上面的字。觀眾超喜歡，笑聲和掌聲比以往都多。表演結束後，校長說：「這是有史以來最棒的一場表演，我會記得很久。」兩天後，Tina 的聲音恢復了。她說的第一句話是：「謝謝你，Ben！」

passages.title: 網購的籃球鞋
passages.text: Mark wanted new basketball shoes, so he {1} a pair online. He waited a week, and finally the box came. But when he tried them on, they were too small! He forgot to check the size. "Why didn't you {2} to check?" asked his sister. Mark felt terrible. The shop said he could not get his money back. Then his sister had an idea. "My friend Leo has small feet, and he wants new shoes too. Maybe he can buy them." Leo tried them on, and they fit perfectly! He {3} to buy them. With the money, Mark went to a real shoe store. Now he never buys shoes {4} trying them on first. Mark and Leo play on the same team, and they {5} every win together in their new shoes.

blanks.why: order + 物「訂購」：他在網路上訂了一雙鞋。joined、caught、agreed a pair 意思不通。
remember to + 原形動詞「記得去做…」：你為什麼沒記得要檢查？agree、join、celebrate 不能接 to check 表示「記得」。
agree to + 原形動詞「同意做…」：Leo 同意把鞋買下來。caught、celebrated、turned 不能接 to buy 表示同意。
without + V-ing「沒有先…」：他現在買鞋一定先試穿。later、than、during 不能這樣接 trying。
celebrate every win「慶祝每一場勝利」。order、collect、catch every win 意思不通。

passages.zh: Mark 想要一雙新的籃球鞋，所以他在網路上訂了一雙。等了一個星期，盒子終於送來了。可是一試穿，鞋子太小了！他忘了檢查尺寸。「你為什麼沒記得要檢查？」他姊姊問。Mark 難過極了，店家說不能退錢。後來姊姊想到一個辦法：「我朋友 Leo 腳很小，他也想要新鞋，也許他可以買。」Leo 一試，剛剛好！他同意把鞋買下來。Mark 拿著這筆錢去了實體鞋店。現在他買鞋一定會先試穿。Mark 和 Leo 在同一支球隊，他們穿著新鞋一起慶祝每一場勝利。
